name: freshdesk
description: Freshdesk helpdesk integration via the Freshdesk REST API v2 — list, search, create, and update support tickets, read ticket conversations, add private/public notes, and look up contacts. Authenticates with a personal Freshdesk API key sent as HTTP Basic auth against your portal URL. Ticket status and priority codes are mapped to readable names (Open/Pending/Resolved/Closed, Low/Medium/High/Urgent) in results.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Freshdesk helpdesk tickets and contacts via the REST API v2

fields.label: Freshdesk URL
fields.helpText: Your Freshdesk portal URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.freshdesk.com

fields.label: API Key
fields.helpText: Your personal Freshdesk API key: log in, open Profile Settings, and click View API key.

tools.name: freshdesk.list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets in the helpdesk, optionally filtered by a predefined view, an updated-since timestamp, and a sort order. Status and priority are returned as readable names.

filter.description: Predefined ticket view to filter by

updatedSince.description: Only tickets updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z)

tools.name: freshdesk.get_ticket
tools.description: Get a ticket's details (subject, description, status, priority, requester) together with its conversation thread of replies and notes.

conversationLimit.description: Max conversation entries to return (default 30, max 100)

tools.name: freshdesk.search_tickets
tools.description: Search tickets with a Freshdesk query expression, e.g. status:2 AND priority:4 or tag:'billing'. The query may be at most 510 characters (the 512-character API limit includes the automatically added surrounding quotes).

query.description: Freshdesk ticket search expression (without surrounding double quotes — they are added automatically), e.g. status:2 AND priority:4. Max 510 characters.

tools.name: freshdesk.search_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts either by a Freshdesk query expression or by exact email address.

query.description: Freshdesk contact search expression (without surrounding double quotes), e.g. name:'Jane'. Max 510 characters.

email.description: Exact email address to look up (used instead of query when provided)

tools.name: freshdesk.create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new support ticket with a subject, description, and requester email; optionally set priority, status, and tags.

email.description: Requester's email address (a contact is created if it does not exist)

tags.description: Tags to attach to the ticket

tools.name: freshdesk.update_ticket
tools.description: Update an existing ticket's status, priority, assigned agent, and/or tags.

ticketId.description: The numeric ticket id to update

responderId.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to

tags.description: Replacement tag list for the ticket

tools.name: freshdesk.add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a ticket — private (agent-only, the default) or public (visible to the requester).

ticketId.description: The numeric ticket id to add the note to

private.description: Whether the note is private/agent-only (default true)
